title: Nhamissa Health Post: AWD Rising, PWTU-07 Down at Tap Stand 2

fields.organization: Harbourlight Relief International — Mozambique Country Office, TC Tevra Response (Health & WASH)
fields.formTitle: Field Report — Health & WASH (sent by WhatsApp)
fields.location: Nhamissa displacement site — health post, tap stand 1 (PWTU-04) and tap stand 2 (PWTU-07)
fields.inspector: Ana Mussa, Health Officer; Edson Cumbe, WASH Officer
fields.unit: HRI Nhamissa team (11 staff), on site behind site management tent
fields.summary: Acute watery diarrhoea (AWD) is rising at Nhamissa: 3 cases Friday, 11 since midnight, 4 of them children under 5, 2 referred. The district health team has taken samples. Cholera is NOT confirmed. Portable water treatment unit PWTU-07 at tap stand 2 stopped at 07:50 with a dosing pump fault. Free residual chlorine at tap stand 2 is now 0.0 mg/L (target 0.5 mg/L). Tap stand 1 (PWTU-04) is still fine at 0.6 mg/L, but its queue has doubled. We need a replacement unit here today. We cannot drive out to collect one because movements are stopped.

findings.notes: Friday: 3. Since 00:00 Saturday: 11 (4 under 5). 2 referred. Samples taken by the district health team. Cholera not confirmed.
Dosing pump fault, stopped 07:50. Restart tried twice and failed. No spare pump on site.
0.0 mg/L at 09:10 (target 0.5 mg/L). Water at this tap is untreated.
About double the normal length since tap stand 2 stopped. Waits are long in the heat.
Only a small working stock at the health post. Not enough for tap stand 2 households beyond today.

findings.item: PWTU stock — LOG stock sheet v3 (signed 07:00 Sat)
findings.notes: 11 usable (10 from Recount 1 + 1 wet unit that passed its test Friday night; the other failed). 2 at Nhamissa (PWTU-04, PWTU-07), 4 allocated to Buzi G-W-01 (UNHAS helicopter 13:00 today), 5 in Beira warehouse. Water tablets dry, enough for 20,000 people for 60 days.

actionsTaken: 09:00 — Tap stand 2 marked 'not for drinking' with the site manager; mobiliser posted at the tap
09:15 — District health team told about the chlorine result at tap stand 2
09:20 — Families from tap stand 2 sent to tap stand 1. ORS available at the health post
09:25 — This report sent to Logistics Manager and Emergency Coordinator
recommendations: Send one replacement PWTU from the Beira warehouse to Nhamissa today
Send water treatment tablets for tap stand 2 households now, until the replacement unit runs
Send a pump technician or a spare dosing pump for PWTU-07 so it can be repaired and returned to stock
Keep AWD case counts and water results shared with the district health team twice a day
fields.photosNote: 3 photos attached: PWTU-07 dosing pump with fault light; chlorine comparator at tap stand 2 reading 0.0 mg/L; queue at tap stand 1. Logistics Manager's stock sheet v3 (PDF) attached.
fields.signature: Ana Mussa, Health Officer · Edson Cumbe, WASH Officer

instructorNote: This page is Version A. If HRI declined G-W-01 at I-15, change the stock line to: 2 at Nhamissa, 9 in Beira, none allocated to Buzi, with G-W-01 reported unassigned and listed for the HCT on Sunday. Watch whether LOG sends a Beira unit without taking any of the 4 committed to Buzi and starts a water-tablet bridge right away, and whether the EC gets a single-vehicle movement approval from the SFP and CD (HMSSSP 5) while keeping the response linked with the district health team.
